title: Penalty for violations.
bodyText: Any person, including any public officer or employee who violates section 264-6, shall be fined not more than $250 or imprisoned not more than three months, or both.
crossReferences: Classification of offense and authorized punishment, see §§701-107, 706-640, and 706-663.

§264-12  Penalty for violations.  Any person, including any public officer or employee who violates section 264-6, shall be fined not more than $250 or imprisoned not more than three months, or both. [L 1967, c 163, pt of §2; HRS §264-12]
